decor.notes: 1-1's scenery is a strict 48-column repeat: a big hill, a bush, a small hill, a bush, a bush
the map's big hill at 144 is cut off by the staircase at 148; scenery here is placed whole or not at all, so it stands as the smaller shape in the columns that are clear
the koopa troopa stands in this one
the map's four-wide bush at 137 has its caps buried in the two mid staircases; the two clear columns between them keep it

the cloud band repeats every 48 columns too: widths 3/3/5/4. the map's own rows are 3/2/3/2; every cloud here sits four rows lower, because the nes shows all fifteen rows at once and our nine-row window rests on rows 6-14, where the map's sky band would never be in shot

smbd_deltas: no smbd-specific terrain/block layout changes for 1-1 were found in the sources used; only the challenge-mode additions (red coins, yoshi egg, medal score) are confirmed smbd-specific content. the nes and smbd map images agree on every structure checked, so the layout below is treated as both.
confidence_notes: the terrain, blocks, enemies, decor, flagpole, castle and bonus room in this file are no longer prose-derived: every column and row was extracted programmatically from the official nes 1-1 map image (3584x480, 16px tiles, 224 columns x 15 playfield rows plus the bonus room below it) by classifying each 16x16 cell against a tile sheet cut from the same image. positions therefore carry "confidence": "measured". block *contents* are still read off the item icons the map draws over each block, cross-checked against mariowiki prose. four deliberate deviations from the measurement are recorded in the notes above: the big hill at map column 144 and the bush at map column 137 are cut off by staircases on the real map, and our compiler places scenery whole or not at all, so they stand as the largest shape that fits the clear columns; the whole cloud band is transposed four rows down, since our camera window never shows the nes sky rows; and the hidden 1-up block keeps its measured column but sits on the standard low block row. the flagpole shaft is one row shorter than the map's because the engine's flag band geometry is fixed at rows 4-12.
